reference_stack.vla: NVIDIA GR00T N1.7 with the pending common HumanoidArena state64/action40 adaptation checkpoint
reference_stack.whole_body_controller: GEAR-SONIC through HumanoidArena's released semantic-v3 action provider

controller_contract.action_interface: 40-dimensional semantic reference pose: root local-XY delta, root Z, root rotation-6D, 29 joints, 2 hands
controller_contract.observation_interface: 64-dimensional state: root heading canonical rotation-6D, 29 joint positions, 29 joint velocities

nominal.purpose: Measure ordinary task success and recovery-module regression

failure_start.purpose: Isolate recovery competence from pre-failure execution quality

online_failure.trigger: shared semantic event or sub-task boundary
online_failure.purpose: Evaluate detection, diagnosis, recovery, and continuation end to end

recovery_levels.L1: Action retry; task state is materially unchanged
recovery_levels.L2: Action adaptation; object state changed but remains directly usable
recovery_levels.L3: Object-state restoration before the original task can continue
recovery_levels.L4: Environment restoration involving a blocking non-target state or object

humanoid_axes.H1: Body-state recovery: support, balance, foot placement, or recoverable fall state
humanoid_axes.H2: Policy-tracker failure: valid high-level intent is not realized by the tracker
humanoid_axes.H3: Coupled failure: body-state and task/object-state disruption co-occur

admission_capture.failure_snapshot_policy: capture after the locked injector settle interval and before any recovery instruction
admission_capture.boundary_driver_selection_rule: A driver is permitted only for a scenario that failed to reach its semantic boundary in the frozen seed-20260915 reference rollout before oracle execution; its parameters are suite-hashed and shared unchanged by admission, oracle, and internal comparisons
admission_capture.boundary_driver_claim_boundary: The driver establishes only the pre-failure semantic boundary; it is disabled immediately when the locked detector fires and never supplies a recovery action

required_before_admission: immutable initial and failure snapshot hashes

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when the box center is judged on a live or fallback shelf support surface

scenarios.event_boundary: the first semantic-action40 hand bit rising edge at the locked 0.5 close threshold
box root is at least 0.05 m above its reset height with speed at most 0.08 m/s continuously for 0.5 s, before task success

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena strict raw reward with OPEN_DOOR_STRICT_REQUIRE_GEOMETRY=1 is 1 when the robot is upright and through the live door frame, the latch is unlocked, and absolute door-leaf angle is at least 60 degrees; the upstream OpenDoor row remains diagnostic while its locked self-tests fail

scenarios.event_boundary: a configured wrist proxy first enters 0.30 m of the live door-handle body while strict task success is false
latch is unlocked and absolute live door-leaf angle first reaches 60 degrees while the geometry-required task predicate remains false

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when object_l (the hammer) center of mass is inside any discovered basket goal box and is not below the ground-drop threshold

scenarios.event_boundary: hammer CoM has moved at least 0.20 m from reset and lifted at least 0.05 m while the single-stage goal predicate remains false

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when the football center crosses a goal-line inner edge within the goal-mouth X and height bounds; fall and safety are reported separately

scenarios.event_boundary: football speed first exceeds 0.25 m/s while the goal predicate remains false

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when a pelvis/hip proxy is in the live sofa-seat volume with at least 5 N contact, or the upstream multi-body seated-geometry fallback passes

scenarios.event_boundary: a pelvis or hip proxy first comes within 0.75 m XY of the live sofa-seat AABB while the seated predicate remains false and the robot is upright

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when any configured punch body enters the per-target hit radius; fall and safety are reported separately

scenarios.event_boundary: a configured punch proxy approaches for three consecutive samples and enters the shell 0.08–0.20 m outside the live hit threshold while success remains false

tasks.success_predicate: HumanoidArena raw reward is 1 when all configured left- and right-foot proxy points are inside the live target region and the robot is upright; collision and safety are reported separately

scenarios.event_boundary: robot root first moves at least 1.0 m in XY from its immutable initial snapshot while the target predicate remains false

fairness_requirements: Identical initial and failure snapshots for every method in a comparison cell
Identical semantic boundary, perturbation parameters, and rollout seed
Identical observation permissions, action rate, horizon, and success predicate
Controller identity and revision reported; controller changes form a separate comparison
No retry outside the episode budget and no silent reset after failure
Every scored recovery scenario is independently oracle-verified recoverable
All episode records, failures, exclusions, seeds, and manifests are retained
